flashpoints.typical_duration: Weeks, when it changes the inflation outlook. Announcement headlines alone rarely stick.
flashpoints.escalation_markers: Rates above expectations, retaliation, or extension to critical minerals and energy.

headlines.title: World News in Brief: Shipping alert from IMO, democracy vanishing in Nicaragua, alert over political ‘denialism’
headlines.summary: Amid a rising number of attacks on shipping in key waterways in the Middle East linked to the US-Iran war, the head of UN maritime agency, Mr. Arsenio Dominguez, has insisted that the conflict is not a “pretext” to target “innocent seafarers”.

headlines.title: Ukraine: Attacks on education threaten an entire generation, UNICEF warns
headlines.summary: In an underground classroom in Sumy, Ukraine, children sit quietly at their desks, busy with the day’s lessons. For the moment they are shielded from the horrors of nearly five years of war, but just barely.

headlines.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
headlines.summary: Some 10 families had reportedly been living in the six-storey building in Gaza City that was hit by an Israeli strike last year.

headlines.title: For checkpoint and settler attack news, Palestinians tune into the radio
headlines.summary: Palestinians in the West Bank navigate Israeli road closures and attacks with help from a local radio station.

headlines.title: Gaza: At least 20 killed in deadly building collapse, search for survivors continues
headlines.summary: Search and rescue operations continued in Gaza City on Wednesday following the collapse of a bombed-out building that killed at least 20 people, according to reports.

geo.caveat: Each flashpoint is measured against its own trailing 30-day median, so a long-running conflict does not sit at maximum forever. This measures how loud a story is relative to its own normal - not what will happen.

profile.name: Initial Jobless Claims
profile.what: New unemployment benefit filings in the prior week. Released every Thursday at 13:30 UK.
profile.why_gold: The highest-frequency labour signal available. Individually minor, but a trend of rising claims shifts the whole rate narrative.
profile.watch: The four-week moving average rather than the weekly print, and continuing claims for whether people are finding new work.
profile.gotchas: Distorted by holidays, weather and state-level administrative quirks. One bad week means nothing.
